errors.description: The tool output did not contain the release date, but the agent assumed it was present and proceeded with incorrect information.

errors.evidence: The task asks for the Wikipedia page corresponding to the 2019 game that won the British Academy Games Awards.
errors.description: The agent misunderstood the task by focusing on the release date and revision history without verifying the game's award status.

errors.evidence:
### 1. Task outcome (short version):
Untitled Goose Game is the 2019 video game that won a British Academy Games Award. Its official Wikipedia page is https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Untitled_Goose_Game, and its initial release date is 20 September 2019 (i.e. the release month is September). Examination of the article’s revision history shows that there were 0 revisions made before September 2019.
